item.title: 📆 Top News Today Kyrgyzstan hosted a meeting of the CIS Defence Ministers' Council. When addressing his counterparts, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov drew their attention
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🌐 Kyrgyzstan hosted a meeting of the CIS Defence Ministers' Council. When addressing his counterparts, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov drew their attention on the fact that current challenges require more close interaction among the CIS states as well as coordination efforts on defending their interests. CIS defence ministers signed the joint work plan for 2027. 🚩 Hammering the enemy : the Sever Group of Forces established over the settlements of Nefyodovka and Chernoye in Kharkov region. 🔥 Sparks flying : Russian Armed Forces hit Ukraine's port infrastructure facilities, as well as ships used in the interests of the Ukrainian Armed Forces. ❌ Two down, that's a wrap: Gerans engaged dry cargo ships in the Bug estuary and in the port of Chernomorsk. ✈️ Crushing blow: Russian jets rain fire on AFU in DPR 🤝 We don't abandon our people: the Tsentr Group evacuates civilians of Krasnoarmeysk and other liberated settlements of the DPR. ⚓️ Operating from Pacific's depths : the Pacific Fleet's nuclear submarine cruiser Novosibirsk fired cruise missiles in the Pacific during a scheduled drill. Steady on course! #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 We don’t abandon our people Servicemen of the 7th Military Commandant's Office of the 51st Combined Arms Army of the Tsentr Group
item.description: We don’t abandon our people 🤝 Servicemen of the 7th Military Commandant's Office of the 51st Combined Arms Army of the Tsentr Group continue to evacuate civilians of Krasnoarmeysk and other liberated settlements of the DPR and provide everything necessary to them. One of those evacuated is an elderly resident of Krasnoarmeysk , Aleksandr Priborenko. His wife was killed by a Ukrainian drone strike, and he himself was left without a home, but he managed to save a wounded Russian assault trooper with the call sign 'Bars'. The pensioner hid the barely conscious soldier in his cellar. Later, the assault trooper was evacuated by his comrades-in-arms, and Aleksander Vladimirovich decided to leave for Leningrad region. Servicemen of the commandant's office accompanied him along the entire evacuation route, protecting him from enemy drones. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30068

We
don’t abandon our people
🤝
Servicemen of the 7th Military Commandant's Office of the 51st Combined Arms Army of the Tsentr Group
continue to evacuate civilians of Krasnoarmeysk and other liberated settlements of the DPR
and provide everything necessary to them.
One of those evacuated is an elderly resident of Krasnoarmeysk
, Aleksandr Priborenko. His wife was killed by a Ukrainian drone strike, and he himself was left without a home, but he managed to save a wounded Russian assault trooper with the call sign 'Bars'. The pensioner hid the barely conscious soldier in his cellar. Later, the assault trooper was evacuated by his comrades-in-arms, and Aleksander Vladimirovich decided to leave for Leningrad region. Servicemen of the commandant's office
accompanied him along the entire evacuation route,
protecting him from enemy drones.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30063

Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov summed up the results of the meeting of the CIS Council of Defence Ministers
.
'
Great attention was given to the organisation of operational and combat training of troops. This area of interaction was the main topic of our meeting,' said Andrei Belousov.
▫️
The head of the Russian military department noted that, within the framework of the meeting, the practice of planning combat training was discussed and priorities for this work in modern conditions were identified, and the ways and methods of employing unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as robotic systems, in modern combat operations were analysed.
'Directions have been identified for introducing the combat experience of the special military operation into the training of troops,' he added.
📈
The meeting considered
issues of enhancing the combat capability potential of troops
and conducting joint military exercises.
'Following the results of the meeting, decisions were signed aimed at further strengthening cooperation and enhancing the combat capabilities of the national armed forces,' said Andrei Belousov.
🤝
In accordance with the agenda of the meeting,
a set of issues was considered aimed at further enhancing the combat capabilities of the armies of the CIS states,
as well as developing interaction in the military sphere. The results and priorities of joint activities in military cooperation in the interests of Eurasian and regional security were analysed, taking into account the international situation.
'The Council approved the results and proposals for the development of joint projects in the field of military education and military sports, as well as the planning and organisation of events in the military sphere. The work plan of the Defence Ministers Council for 2027 has been approved,' noted the Russian Defence Minister.
✅
In his assessment, 'the meeting once again confirmed
the relevance and demand for developing cooperation within the format of the Council of Defence Ministers
to maintain stability within the Commonwealth'.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

Units of the Tsentr Group of Forces inflicted damage
on personnel and equipment of four mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, a marine brigade and two national guard brigades near Krutoyarovka in Dnepropetrovsk region, and Belozerskoye, Novoyavlenka, Druzhkovka, Starovarvarovka, Veselaya Gora, Roganskoye, Yuryevka and Gornyak in the Donetsk People's Republic.
⚡️
In Dobropolye
(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army advanced in the north-western part of the city. The Group's assault units continued their offensive in the western part of the settlement.
📊
Over the course of the day, 31 buildings were liberated and up to 15 Ukrainian servicemen were neutralised.
▪️
In total, in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group, the losses of Ukrainian armed formations amounted to up to 345 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units continued to advance to the depths of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted damage on personnel and hardware of two air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and two marine brigades close to Tarasovka, Ivanovka, Kolomiytsy, Chernenkovo, Vasilkovka, and Podgavrilovka in Dnepropetrovsk region, and Mirolyubovka and Rayskoye in Zaporozhye region.
▪️
The Ukrainian Armed Forces lost over 190 troops, six motor vehicles, a Grad MLRS combat vehicle, and an electronic warfare station.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They hit formations of two mechanised brigades and a mountain assault brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces close to Orekhov, Balabino and Kushugum in Zaporozhye region.
▪️
Up to 30 Ukrainian troops and 13 motor vehicles were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops and artillery of the Russian groups of forces

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region are tightening the encirclement and expanding the outer control zone.
🚩
Within the encirclement, as a result of the active actions of our units,
control has been established over the settlements of Nefyodovka and Chernoye in Kharkov region.
💥
Fighting continues for the liberation of Nikolayevka and Varvarovka in Kharkov region.
👊
As part of the expanding of the outer control zone,
fighting continues to establish control over the settlements of Prikolotnoye, Kotovka and Gogino in Kharkov region.
🔥
Fire strikes were delivered against strongholds of a heavy mechanised brigade and an assault regiment of the Ukrainian Armed Forces close to Fedorovka and Maly Burluk in Kharkov region.
💥
Also in Kharkov region,
personnel and equipment of three mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades and two assault regiments of the Ukrainian Armed Forces were hit close to Liptsy, Velikiye Prokhody, Zamulovka, Shirokoye, Zarechnoye, Pershotravnevoye, Kurgannoye, Veliky Burluk, Vysoky and Gontarovka.
🔥
In Sumy region,
formations of a mechanised brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and two territorial defence brigades were hit in the areas of the settlements of Leninskoye, Barilovka and Pervomayskoye in Sumy region.
▪️
In total, in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group the enemy lost over 175 servicemen, 16 motor vehicles and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Zapad Group improved their position along the forward edge.
They inflicted damage on personnel and equipment of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and a territorial defence brigade in the areas of the settlements of Mayaki, Karpovka, and Donetskoye in the Donetsk People's Republic, and Chervony Oskol and Maliyevka in Kharkov region.
▪️
Ukrainian Armed Forces losses amounted to up to 220 servicemen, three armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, three artillery pieces and a Grad MLRS combat vehicle.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted damage on formations of a mechanised brigade, a mountain assault brigade and an airmobile brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in the areas of the settlements of Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Semenovka, Vysokoivanovka, and Krasny Molochar in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 145 servicemen, 33 motor vehicles and two field artillery pieces.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
